All Schemes.Scheme Name: Additional Capital Subsidy for Micro Manufacturing Enterprises
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible micro manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu can apply, subject to the State’s capital-subsidy rules for eligible plant and machinery.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: All new micro manufacturing enterprises established anywhere in Tamil Nadu are eligible for the additional micro-enterprise capital subsidy, subject to the State capital-subsidy guidelines and excluded-activity list.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official TN MSME page confirms 10% additional capital subsidy for micro enterprises, up to ₹5 lakh.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Additional Capital Subsidy for promotion of cleaner and environment-friendly technologies
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: New or existing eligible manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu adopting approved cleaner or environment-friendly technologies can apply.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: New and existing eligible enterprises adopting cleaner and environment-friendly technology can qualify, subject to the notified technology and capital-subsidy conditions.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official TN MSME page confirms 25% additional subsidy on qualifying plant/machinery, up to ₹10 lakh.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Additional Capital Subsidy for scaling up
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Existing micro and small manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu that scale up through eligible expansion or diversification can apply.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Existing micro and small manufacturing enterprises anywhere in Tamil Nadu that graduate to a higher category through expansion/diversification are eligible, subject to the scheme guidelines.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official source confirms 5% additional capital subsidy up to ₹25 lakh for scaling up.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Additional Capital Subsidy for select category of entrepreneurs
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible manufacturing enterprises owned by women, SC/ST, differently abled or transgender entrepreneurs can receive the additional subsidy.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Eligible enterprises set up by Women, SC, ST, Differently Abled and Transgender entrepreneurs can receive the additional subsidy, subject to ownership and capital-subsidy conditions.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official TN MSME page lists the eligible entrepreneur categories.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Manufacturer exporters or merchant exporters tied to supporting manufacturers can apply for Advance Authorisation, subject to DGFT export-obligation and input norms.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Manufacturer exporters and merchant exporters tied to supporting manufacturers may obtain Advance Authorisation for duty-free inputs used in export production, subject to DGFT input-output, export-obligation and Actual User conditions.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Existing text is broadly consistent with DGFT policy, but the audit will not mark it fully verified until the exact current DGFT source is attached.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Agarbatti Making Project - Gramodyog Vikas Yojana(GVY)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible agarbatti artisans, SHGs or groups can receive training/equipment support under the programme, subject to KVIC beneficiary and prior-assistance conditions.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Beneficiary eligibility is governed by KVIC’s Gramodyog Vikas Yojana agarbatti programme and its current selection/training guidelines.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Scheme identity is valid; exact current beneficiary conditions still need a directly citable KVIC guideline.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Annai Therasa Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Orphan Girls
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Orphan girls aged 18+ at the time of marriage are eligible. There is no income ceiling; educational requirements apply only to the higher-assistance category.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Orphan girls are eligible. The bride must have completed 18 years at marriage; there is no upper age or income limit. Scheme II requires an eligible degree or diploma; Scheme I has no educational requirement.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Previous wording should be corrected: official TN material states no income limit.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: SC/ST entrepreneurs aged up to 55 whose enterprise is 100% owned by SC/ST persons can apply for new or expansion projects. No minimum educational qualification is required.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Individuals belonging to SC/ST communities, up to 55 years of age, may apply for new or expansion projects; no minimum educational qualification is required. The enterprise must be 100% owned by SC/ST persons.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official AABCS portal confirms SC/ST ownership, age and qualification rules.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: ASCEND is aimed at startups, entrepreneurs and ecosystem participants in Northeast India. Eligibility depends on the specific workshop or event rather than a single permanent applicant rule.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: ASCEND/related Startup India women capacity-building workshops were intended for aspiring and existing women entrepreneurs; eligibility depended on the workshop cohort and registration requirements.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: The workbook label 'ASCEND' needs scheme-identity checking; Startup India official pages clearly document Women for Startups and WING programmes, but this exact label requires confirmation.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Assistance to Exporters for Rapid Food Testing Devices and Kits
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligibility could not be reliably verified from a sufficiently specific current official guideline in this research pass.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Registered/eligible spice exporters purchasing approved rapid quality and safety testing devices/kits can receive assistance under Spices Board export-development guidelines, subject to category and eligible-cost rules.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Current working procedure confirms assistance for rapid food testing devices and kits.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Assistance to Facilitate Emergency Response against Corona Virus scheme (SAFE)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: SAFE was a COVID-era SIDBI emergency facility for eligible MSMEs producing or supplying medical and allied products. Eligibility depended on SIDBI credit checks and the applicable SAFE/SAFE Plus conditions.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: SAFE was a COVID-era SIDBI emergency assistance facility for eligible MSMEs involved in products/services required to fight the pandemic, subject to SIDBI credit conditions.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Do not present this as a current open scheme; it was pandemic-specific.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Assistance to Re-energize Capital Investments by Small and Medium Enterprises (ARISE)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: ARISE targeted existing MSMEs undertaking expansion, modernization or other capital expenditure. Applicants generally needed an operating track record, audited financials, cash profit and satisfactory credit assessment by SIDBI.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: ARISE supported eligible existing/brownfield SMEs for expansion, modernization or capital expenditure, subject to SIDBI appraisal and scheme conditions.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Available scheme descriptions indicate a validity ending in 2022; current official archival confirmation is still required.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Institutions under the Ministry of MSME and existing State-level Entrepreneurship Development Institutes (EDIs) can apply for infrastructure/training assistance under the ATI scheme.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Under the current ATI description, institutions of the Ministry of MSME and existing State-level Entrepreneurship Development Institutes are eligible for infrastructure assistance; programme support follows ATI guidelines.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Previous text was too broad; current Ministry page is narrower for 'Who can apply'.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Higher-education/R&D institutions and eligible non-academic applicants such as companies, accelerators, SEBI-registered AIFs, groups or individuals can apply to establish an Atal Incubation Centre, subject to AIM requirements.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Higher-education/R&D institutions and eligible non-academic applicants including corporate enterprises, SEBI-registered AIFs, accelerators, groups and individuals may apply, subject to AIM requirements including dedicated incubation space.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official AIM page lists applicant categories and infrastructure requirement.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: AIM is an umbrella innovation mission rather than a single beneficiary scheme. Eligibility depends on the specific AIM programme, such as ATL, AIC or other innovation initiatives.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: AIM is an umbrella mission rather than one beneficiary grant. Eligibility depends on the specific AIM programme, such as ATL or AIC.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Workbook should not treat AIM itself as having one universal applicant eligibility rule.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Atal Tinkering Labs are intended for eligible schools to create innovation/STEM workspaces for students, particularly Classes 6–12. School selection is subject to AIM’s infrastructure and programme requirements.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: ATLs are established in eligible schools. Selection has included infrastructure, faculty, enrolment/attendance, student performance, science-activity participation and partnership criteria under ATL guidelines.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Previous wording 'particularly Classes 6–12' was too loose; official application criteria should be used.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible micro and small enterprises in Tamil Nadu that take qualifying term loans for technology upgradation or modernization can claim the back-ended interest subsidy, subject to the applicable loan and scheme conditions.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Micro and small manufacturing enterprises can receive back-ended interest subsidy on qualifying term loans for technology upgradation/modernization and eligible credit-guarantee-linked loans, subject to Tamil Nadu MSME guidelines.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Current TN disclosure specifies the subsidy structure and eligible MSE manufacturing enterprises.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Micro and small enterprises seeking bank finance can use NSIC’s Bank Credit Facilitation support. Actual loan eligibility and sanction depend on the participating bank’s credit appraisal and lending requirements.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Any MSME unit can approach NSIC for bank credit facilitation. Loan sanction remains subject to the participating bank’s documentation and credit appraisal.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Official NSIC page explicitly says any MSME unit can approach the nearest branch.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Beekeepers/farmers and other beneficiaries selected under KVIC’s Gramodyog Vikas Yojana beekeeping activity can receive training and beekeeping assistance, subject to the applicable KVIC selection guidelines.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: Beneficiary eligibility depends on the current KVIC Gramodyog Vikas Yojana beekeeping component and beneficiary-selection/training rules.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Exact current beneficiary criteria still need a directly citable KVIC guideline.

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: BBBP is an awareness and social-behaviour-change programme for improving outcomes for the girl child, not an individual cash-benefit scheme. Therefore, there is no standard individual beneficiary application eligibility.
All Schemes.Verified Eligibility: BBBP is a behavioural and social-change programme and has no Direct Benefit Transfer provision; there is no individual cash-benefit application eligibility.
All Schemes.Verification Notes: Current Ministry-linked official page explicitly states there is no DBT under BBBP.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Bhamashah Techno Fund - Women-led Startup Fund
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Rajasthan-registered women-led startups eligible under the iStart framework can seek support from the women-earmarked Bhamashah Techno Fund, subject to startup evaluation and funding approval.
Employed or unemployed women scientists up to 45 years old can apply for BioCARe when it is their first extramural research grant.
Indian innovators/startups working on biotechnology ideas with commercialization potential can apply. Applicants must meet BIRAC’s incubation/company and R&D requirements for the relevant BIG call.
Indian biotechnology companies undertaking high-risk, innovation-led R&D with commercial potential can seek BIPP support, subject to BIRAC’s company, project and cost-sharing requirements.
BIRAC-supported biotech startups seeking follow-on equity can access AcE Fund support through eligible investment channels, subject to the fund’s startup and investment-selection requirements.
Biotech/life-sciences startups can access LEAP funding through BIRAC LEAP Fund partner incubators. The startup must satisfy the partner’s investment assessment and BIRAC programme conditions.
Post-Proof-of-Concept biotech startups with promising innovations can seek SEED support through selected BIRAC BioNEST SEED Fund partner incubators.

New micro manufacturing enterprises anywhere in Tamil Nadu and eligible new small/medium manufacturing enterprises in notified thrust sectors can apply. Service enterprises and notified ineligible activities are excluded.
Women entrepreneurs aged 18+ can seek Cent Kalyani finance for eligible micro/small business activities, subject to Central Bank of India’s applicable credit appraisal and scheme conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Chhattisgarh Innovation and Venture Capital Funds - Women Innovator Corpus
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible startups operating in Chhattisgarh can access state startup funding; women-led startups receive special-category support when a woman founder holds more than 51% shareholding.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Families with one or two girl children and no male child can apply, subject to Tamil Nadu residence, family-income and family-planning conditions. Applications must also meet the scheme’s child-age requirements.

Micro and small enterprises using institutional term finance for approved technology upgradation can qualify for CLCSS support. The machinery/technology and lending institution must satisfy the scheme guidelines.

Eligibility depends on the specific Coir Vikas Yojana component. Support is generally intended for eligible coir workers, artisans, entrepreneurs, enterprises and other beneficiaries in the coir sector.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Coir Vikas Yojana- Export Market Promotion
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Manufacturers, entrepreneurs and exporters of coir can apply for Export Market Promotion assistance. Component-specific conditions apply for fairs, buyer-seller meets, delegations and other export-promotion activities.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Coir Vikas Yojana - Umbrella scheme- Skill Upgradation and Mahila Coir Yojana
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Rural women artisans in coir-producing regions can apply for Mahila Coir Yojana training and subsidized equipment. Other skill-development components cover eligible coir workers/trainees selected under Coir Board guidelines.

Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under SPRS, or applying for SPRS with required inspection completed before tender filing, can participate. Pure trading units without value addition, packing or branding are excluded.

The Cradle Baby Scheme is a child-protection programme for abandoned/surrendered infants rather than an applicant-based subsidy. Babies received through designated cradle centres are taken into government protection and care.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible micro and small enterprises obtaining credit from a CGTMSE member lending institution can receive guarantee-backed finance. Covered facilities must meet CGTMSE rules, including applicable collateral/third-party guarantee conditions.
All Schemes.Source: India - Women Entrepreneurship Support Schemes | MSME Funding Reference Guide (India) | MSME Schemes 2025-26 | TN MSME Compendium 2022

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: DPIIT-recognised startups that are not in default or classified as NPAs can qualify for CGSS-backed debt. Eligibility must also be certified by the participating member lending/investing institution.

Indian manufacturers or eligible main/sub-contractors making supplies in categories notified as 'deemed exports' under the Foreign Trade Policy can claim applicable benefits. The goods must be manufactured in India and satisfy the relevant supply conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Rural youth aged 15–35 from poor families can receive skill training under DDU-GKY. Relaxations apply to specified vulnerable groups under programme guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: DAY-NRLM primarily targets poor and vulnerable rural households, especially women, by organizing them into Self-Help Groups and related community institutions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: DAY-NULM targets urban poor households for self-employment, skills and livelihood support. Eligibility varies by component and is generally linked to identification as an urban poor beneficiary.

Women engaged in manufacturing, services, retail or eligible self-employment activities can apply. The woman should generally own the business or hold more than 50% stake, subject to the lending bank’s conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Domestic events : For participating and visiting business explorations/ exhibitions
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs and recognized MSME associations can receive support for approved domestic exhibitions, buyer-seller meets or business-exploration events, subject to the event and reimbursement conditions.

Eligibility depends on the Coir Board’s Domestic Market Promotion component. Support is aimed at eligible coir-sector institutions, producers and activities that promote coir and coir products in the domestic market.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Ninaivu Widow Remarriage Assistance Scheme
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Widows who remarry can receive assistance; there is no income ceiling. Scheme-I has no educational requirement, while Scheme-II is for eligible degree or diploma holders.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Ninaivu Inter-Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Inter-caste married couples are eligible where the marriage meets Tamil Nadu’s notified community-category conditions. There is no income ceiling or minimum education requirement; graduates/diploma holders qualify for the higher assistance category.

Selected women Self-Help Groups under DAY-NRLM can receive drone assistance for providing agricultural rental services. Selection is based on the SHG’s suitability and local demand for agricultural drone services.

Exporter applicants with a valid IEC can seek DFIA for eligible export products under SION, subject to DGFT rules. The scheme requires the prescribed value addition and excludes inputs subject to specified pre-import or Actual User conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: E.V.R. Maniyammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme for Daughters of Poor Widows
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Daughters of poor widows aged 18+ at the time of marriage can apply, subject to Tamil Nadu’s prescribed family-income limit. The higher assistance category requires an eligible degree or diploma.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Economic Empowerment of Women Enterprises and Start-Ups by Women
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women entrepreneurs and women-led enterprises/startups can participate in the programme for entrepreneurship development and market access. Detailed eligibility depends on the specific training or support activity offered under the programme.
Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs/entrepreneurs developing or adopting commercially viable technologies can seek support, subject to EDII-TN’s project appraisal and applicable fund guidelines.

Aspiring entrepreneurs and startups supported through EDII-TN’s incubation ecosystem can access mentoring/incubation assistance. Selection depends on the relevant incubator/programme and the viability or innovation potential of the venture.

Individuals aged 18+ who are aspiring entrepreneurs, existing entrepreneurs or MSME owners can participate. Implementing agencies determine programme-specific qualifications and participant requirements.
Eligible academic institutions conducting approved entrepreneurship/MSME-related events can seek support, subject to the Tamil Nadu MSME event-assistance guidelines and sanction conditions.

Manufacturer exporters, merchant exporters tied to supporting manufacturers, and eligible service providers can use EPCG. The authorisation is subject to DGFT conditions, including the applicable export obligation.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Financial Assistance for participation in International Trade Fair
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs participating in approved international trade fairs/exhibitions can seek financial assistance. Reimbursement is subject to event approval and the applicable MSME participation guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Financing end to end Energy Efficiency Investments in MSMEs (4E Financing scheme)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs planning commercially viable energy-efficiency investments can seek 4E financing, subject to technical assessment, expected energy savings and SIDBI’s credit appraisal.

FFS does not fund startups directly. Eligible SEBI-registered Category I or II AIFs with a startup investment strategy can seek SIDBI contribution, subject to fund-size, investment commitment and fund-manager requirements.

Eligible MSMEs requiring term finance for business expansion, modernization or other approved capital expenditure can apply. Sanction depends on the lender’s financial, repayment-capacity and credit appraisal requirements.

Eligible micro and small manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu that purchase and install qualifying generator sets can claim subsidy, subject to the State’s prescribed capacity, investment and incentive conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) Women-owned MSME Procurement Support
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women-owned MSEs registered on GeM can access procurement opportunities and women-focused marketplace support. The enterprise must meet GeM seller registration and applicable MSE/women-ownership requirements.

Eligible micro and small enterprises seeking institutional credit can obtain guarantee-backed finance through the applicable MSE guarantee programme. Eligibility depends on the specific guarantee scheme, lender and credit facility.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Implementation of Food Safety and Quality Assurance Mechanisms/ Certifications
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Registered spice exporters and eligible processing/export units implementing approved food-safety or quality-assurance systems/certifications can seek assistance, subject to Spices Board component guidelines and eligible expenditure.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Incentives for setting up new clusters units on the outskirts of Towns and Cities
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible manufacturing enterprises establishing units in approved clusters on the outskirts of towns/cities in Tamil Nadu can receive the notified incentives, subject to cluster, location and investment conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Incentives to entrepreneurs for shifting of existing units outside Urban areas
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible existing manufacturing enterprises that relocate from urban/congested areas to approved locations outside urban areas in Tamil Nadu can claim incentives, subject to relocation and investment conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Infrastructure Subsidy for privately developed industrial estates
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible private developers establishing industrial estates for micro and small enterprises in Tamil Nadu can seek infrastructure subsidy, subject to the prescribed minimum area, infrastructure and approval conditions.

Eligible MSMEs/startups in Tamil Nadu can use Innovation Vouchers to obtain approved innovation, R&D or technology services from recognized knowledge/service providers, subject to the programme’s project and cost-sharing rules.

Eligible exporters of notified products can receive interest equalisation on qualifying rupee export credit through participating banks. Eligibility is governed by the current DGFT/RBI scheme coverage, exporter category and product rules.

Eligible MSME industry associations, government bodies and registered organizations can seek support for approved international cooperation activities such as delegations, exhibitions and conferences, subject to Ministry of MSME guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: International event : For participation in exhibitions
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs participating in approved international exhibitions/trade fairs can claim assistance, subject to event approval, MSME status and applicable reimbursement limits.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: International event : For visiting business exploration/ exhibitions/ buyer-seller meets
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs undertaking approved international business-exploration visits, exhibitions or buyer-seller meets can seek support, subject to the prescribed event and reimbursement conditions.

Eligible women aged 21+ who are recognized as women heads of families in Tamil Nadu can receive the benefit, subject to the scheme’s family income, property, electricity-consumption and other exclusion criteria.

Eligibility varies by KGVY component and generally covers khadi/village-industry artisans, institutions and entrepreneurs selected under KVIC guidelines for training, tools, infrastructure or enterprise support.

Khadi institutions and artisans meeting KVIC requirements can receive assistance under Khadi Vikas Yojana components. Eligibility varies by the specific support component and institutional/artisan status.
Women members of Self-Help Groups under DAY-NRLM are supported to achieve sustainable annual household income of at least ₹1 lakh through diversified livelihood activities and capacity building.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Loan for Purchase of Equipment for Enterprise's Development (SPEED)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs seeking finance to purchase machinery/equipment for enterprise development can apply, subject to the lending institution’s MSME status, equipment, repayment-capacity and credit-appraisal requirements.

Eligible new micro manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu can receive LT power tariff subsidy for the prescribed period, subject to location, commencement, electricity-connection and State incentive conditions.

Women from poor and vulnerable households in Tamil Nadu can join Self-Help Groups under Mahalir Thittam for savings, credit, livelihood and capacity-building support, subject to TNCDW/SHG inclusion guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Maharashtra Women-led Startup GST/Utility/Participation Reimbursement Support
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women-led startups/enterprises in Maharashtra can claim notified reimbursements when they meet the State startup/MSME policy’s women-ownership, registration, investment and eligible-expense conditions.
Women artisans in coir-producing regions can receive training and subsidized equipment under Mahila Coir Yojana, subject to Coir Board selection and training requirements.

Women entrepreneurs and women-led SHGs/NGOs producing goods or services were eligible to use Mahila E-Haat for online market access. The platform was an enabling marketplace initiative rather than a cash-benefit scheme.
Women aged 21–40 from the local community can be selected as Mahila Police Volunteers, subject to the prescribed educational, residency and background requirements of the implementing State/UT.

The Mahila Samman Savings Certificate was available to women and girls, with accounts opened by an adult woman herself or by a guardian for a minor girl. It was a time-bound small-savings scheme available for accounts opened up to 31 March 2025.

Eligible women from notified disadvantaged/backward sections can receive concessional finance for income-generating activities, subject to the implementing corporation’s income, category and lending conditions.

Women entrepreneurs running or starting eligible micro-enterprises can access MUDRA-linked finance through participating lenders. Eligibility follows PMMY business-activity, loan-category and lender appraisal requirements.

Women entrepreneurs seeking to establish or expand eligible small-scale/service businesses can access Mahila Udyam Nidhi assistance, subject to the lending institution’s project-cost, promoter-contribution and credit conditions.

Eligible Khadi and Polyvastra institutions and other approved beneficiaries under KVIC can receive MPDA support for production, marketing and artisan incentives, subject to KVIC certification and programme conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Marketing Development Assistance to registered MSME associations
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Registered MSME associations in Tamil Nadu can seek marketing-development assistance for approved promotional activities/events, subject to association eligibility, prior approval and reimbursement conditions.
Aspiring and existing entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu seeking business guidance can use MentorTN, with mentor matching/support depending on the programme’s registration and mentoring requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Micro and Small Enterprises- Cluster Development Programme (MSE- CDP)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Existing industrial clusters/groups of micro and small enterprises and eligible implementing agencies can seek MSE-CDP support for common facilities and infrastructure, subject to cluster viability, SPV and project-approval conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Micro & Small Enterprises Facilitation Councils (MSEFC)/ MSME SAMADHAAN Scheme
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Micro and small enterprises with delayed payments from buyers can approach the MSE Facilitation Council through MSME Samadhaan. The enterprise must qualify as a micro or small enterprise under the applicable MSME rules.

Eligible groups/clusters of micro enterprises in Tamil Nadu can receive support for common facilities and cluster development, subject to cluster formation, project viability and State approval conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Ministry of MSME Entrepreneurship and Skill Development Programme (ESDP)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Aspiring entrepreneurs and existing entrepreneurs/MSMEs can participate in entrepreneurship and skill-development programmes. Participant eligibility varies by programme type and implementing institution.

Children below six years, pregnant women, lactating mothers and eligible adolescent girls are covered through Anganwadi/nutrition services, with eligibility depending on the specific Poshan 2.0 component.

Mission Shakti supports women and girls through safety, protection and empowerment components. Eligibility depends on the specific service or sub-scheme, such as One Stop Centres, women helplines or support facilities.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn Thittam)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible girl students who studied Classes 6–12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and pursue recognized higher education can receive the monthly assistance, subject to the scheme’s education and enrollment conditions.

MSMEs can access the Champions framework for grievance resolution, handholding and support relating to finance, technology, markets and government schemes. Specific assistance depends on the relevant Champions component.
All Schemes.Source: India - Women Entrepreneurship Support Schemes | MSME Schemes 2025-26

All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Udyam-registered MSMEs can participate in the MSME Competitive (LEAN) Scheme to implement lean manufacturing practices, subject to registration and the applicable Basic, Intermediate or Advanced LEAN level requirements.
Micro and small enterprises can use MSME Global Mart for B2B market access and business opportunities, subject to NSIC membership/registration requirements for the relevant services.

Registered MSMEs with a valid Udyam registration can seek design intervention support. Manufacturing MSMEs are generally expected to be viable, while student-design projects must involve students from recognized institutions.
Individuals, students and MSMEs with innovative ideas can apply through registered Host Institutions. The idea should be capable of development into a proof-of-concept, prototype or viable business.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: MSME Innovative Scheme (Intellectual Property Rights - IPR)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Manufacturing MSMEs with valid UAM/Udyam registration can seek IPR support for eligible patent, trademark, GI and design registration activities.
Micro and small enterprises facing delayed payments from buyers can file cases through MSME Samadhaan for consideration by the relevant Micro and Small Enterprises Facilitation Council.
Eligible MSMEs can apply online for MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification. Participation requires MSME/Udyam status and compliance with the requirements of the chosen ZED certification level.

Naan Mudhalvan primarily serves Tamil Nadu students and youth through skill development, career guidance and competitive-exam programmes. Eligibility varies by the specific course, scholarship or coaching programme.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Nagaland Startup Fund - 25% Reservation for Women-led Ventures
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women-led startups eligible under the Nagaland Startup framework can access the women-reserved portion of the Startup Fund, subject to the State’s startup recognition, ownership and funding-selection requirements.
Women from notified minority communities were eligible for leadership-development training under Nai Roshni, with beneficiary selection following the programme’s age, income and community guidelines.

Eligible women in Tamil Nadu seeking agricultural land ownership can receive support under the Nannilam scheme, subject to the notified women-beneficiary, land-purchase and socio-economic eligibility conditions.

Women facing minor disputes or seeking community-level grievance redressal can approach Nari Adalats in implementing areas. The programme focuses on accessible alternative dispute resolution and does not require conventional financial-benefit eligibility.

Individuals and institutions that have made outstanding contributions to women’s empowerment may be nominated for the Nari Shakti Puraskar, subject to the award year’s nomination categories and eligibility rules.

SC/ST-owned micro and small enterprises can access capacity building, market linkage, procurement and other support under the National SC-ST Hub, subject to applicable MSE registration and SC/ST ownership requirements.
DPIIT-recognised startups can apply for National Startup Awards when they meet the award edition’s incorporation, recognition, compliance and category-specific requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: New Entrepreneur cum Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: First-generation entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu can apply to start a new manufacturing or service enterprise, subject to the scheme’s age, educational qualification, project-cost and promoter-contribution requirements.
Nirbhaya Safe City is a government city-safety infrastructure programme rather than an individual beneficiary scheme. Projects are implemented by approved government agencies in selected cities.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Odisha Startup Policy - Women Entrepreneur Allowance & Marketing Support
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women-led startups recognised under Odisha’s startup framework can access applicable allowance and marketing support, subject to women-ownership, startup recognition and component-specific conditions.

Women affected by violence can access One Stop Centre services including medical, legal, police, counselling and temporary shelter support. Assistance is available regardless of age, class, caste, education, marital status or race.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Packaging development, Bar Coding, QR code, Electronic Product Code (EPC)/ Radio Frequency Identification (RFID)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible micro and small enterprises can seek support for approved packaging, barcode, QR code, EPC or RFID adoption, subject to MSME registration and the relevant reimbursement/assistance guidelines.

Children generally from 6 months to 6 years can receive day-care/crèche services under Palna, particularly to support mothers’ participation in work and other activities. Access depends on availability and the applicable Anganwadi-cum-Crèche or standalone crèche component.

Eligible MSMEs/exporters participating in approved international fairs or exhibitions can seek assistance, subject to prior approval, valid enterprise registration and the applicable reimbursement conditions.

Eligible employers/enterprises creating new jobs can receive payroll-related subsidy where provided under the applicable incentive policy. Eligibility depends on new employment, payroll records and the scheme’s location/investment conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Urban street vendors who were vending on or before the scheme’s cut-off date and are identified through a Certificate of Vending/ID, survey list or eligible recommendation can apply for working-capital loans.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: PM Vishwakarma- Enabling Artisans & Craftspeople to scale-up their Enterprises
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Artisans and craftspeople aged 18+ working in one of the notified traditional trades can apply. Only one member per family is eligible, and specified government employees/families and recent beneficiaries of similar self-employment credit schemes are excluded.
Selected traditional pottery artisans can receive training, tools/equipment and enterprise support under GVY, subject to KVIC beneficiary-selection and programme conditions.
Indian youth meeting the age and course-specific requirements can enroll in eligible PMKVY skill training. Candidate eligibility varies by training type, job role and certification requirements.

Eligible pregnant and lactating women can receive maternity benefits for the first child, with additional benefit for an eligible second child when the second child is a girl, subject to scheme exclusions and registration conditions.

Non-corporate, non-farm micro enterprises and entrepreneurs seeking loans for eligible manufacturing, trading, service and allied agricultural activities can apply through participating lenders under MUDRA.
Adult women from poor households without an existing LPG connection in the household can apply for a PMUY LPG connection, subject to the prescribed deprivation/eligible-category and KYC conditions.

Individuals aged 18+ and eligible institutions can apply to establish a new micro-enterprise. Educational qualification is required for projects above prescribed cost thresholds, and only new units are eligible for subsidy.

Eligible borrowers engaged in RBI-defined priority sectors such as agriculture, MSMEs, education, housing and specified weaker sections can receive priority-sector credit. Eligibility and limits depend on the applicable RBI category and lender rules.

Eligible micro and small enterprises can receive support for approved trade fairs, exhibitions, vendor development, packaging, barcoding and other market-access activities, subject to PMS component guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Product Research and Development (for registered exporters/ institutions)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Registered spice exporters and eligible institutions undertaking approved product research or development can seek assistance, subject to Spices Board registration, project approval and eligible-cost conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Promotion of Energy Audit & Conservation of Energy (PEACE)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs in Tamil Nadu undertaking approved energy audits and energy-conservation measures can seek assistance, subject to MSME status, approved audit/implementation and reimbursement conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Promotion of Indian Spice Brands Abroad
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Registered exporters developing and promoting Indian spice brands in overseas markets can seek assistance, subject to Spices Board registration, brand ownership/approval and eligible export-promotion expenditure.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Promotion of MSME in NER and SIKKIM
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible new and existing MSMEs in the North Eastern Region and Sikkim can receive support for technology centres, common facilities and infrastructure, subject to location, project and implementing-agency conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Punjab Startup Fund - 25% Reservation for Women-led Ventures
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women-led startups recognised under Punjab’s startup framework can access the women-reserved portion of the Startup Fund, subject to ownership, recognition and investment-selection requirements.

RAMP primarily supports MSMEs through State and national programmes that improve market access, finance, technology and institutional capacity. Eligibility depends on the specific RAMP intervention being implemented.

Women from poor and low-income households were supported through microcredit routed mainly via eligible intermediary organizations/SHGs. RMK was an institutional microfinance programme rather than a direct conventional bank-loan scheme for individuals.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Raw Material Assistance (RMA) against bank guarantee
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Micro and small enterprises can obtain NSIC assistance for purchasing raw materials against a bank guarantee, subject to valid enterprise registration, required security and NSIC appraisal/assistance conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Reimbursement of fees for Certificate of Registration as Exporter of Spices (CRES)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible spice exporters obtaining or renewing the required CRES registration can seek reimbursement where covered by the applicable Spices Board export-development assistance guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Reimbursement of Stamp duty and Registration charges
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible enterprises investing in approved projects can claim reimbursement of stamp duty and registration charges, subject to the applicable State industrial/MSME policy, location and investment conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Reservation for MSMEs in land parks setup by SIPCOT
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs establishing units in SIPCOT industrial parks can access land reserved for MSMEs, subject to SIPCOT allotment rules, enterprise category and park-specific availability.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Revamped Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Traditional-industry artisans organized into eligible clusters can benefit under SFURTI. Proposals are implemented through approved agencies and SPVs subject to cluster size, viability and scheme guidelines.
Working women, women under job training and eligible accompanying children can use Sakhi Niwas hostels, subject to local income, distance/residence and hostel admission conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: SANKALP: Hub for Empowerment of Women (HEW)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women and girls can access information, referral and empowerment support through the Hub for Empowerment of Women. Eligibility depends on the specific service or government scheme being facilitated.
All Schemes.Source: India - Women Entrepreneurship Support Schemes | Women Empowerment - Tamil Nadu Analysis

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Sathiyavanimuthu Ammaiyar Ninaivu Free Supply of Sewing Machine Scheme
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible poor women in Tamil Nadu with tailoring skills can receive a free sewing machine, subject to the State’s prescribed age, income and beneficiary-category requirements.
Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs obtaining approved quality certifications can seek reimbursement assistance, subject to MSME registration, recognized certification and eligible certification expenditure.
Eligible adolescent girls can receive nutrition, health, life-skills and related support under the programme. Coverage depends on the age group and implementation guidelines applicable to the scheme.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industries and Entrepreneurship (ASPIRE)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible government/private institutions and agencies can establish Livelihood Business Incubators under ASPIRE to promote rural entrepreneurship and micro-enterprise creation, subject to Ministry of MSME approval.

Eligible institutions, researchers, innovators or enterprises undertaking approved science and technology projects can seek support, subject to the specific programme’s research, innovation and project-approval conditions.

Eligible MSMEs with suitable collateral/security can apply for secured business finance. Approval depends on business vintage, repayment capacity, financial performance and the lender’s credit appraisal.

Viable MSMEs with growth potential can receive equity/quasi-equity support through daughter funds backed by the SRI Fund. Investment is made through eligible SEBI-registered AIFs rather than directly by the fund.

Eligible registered exporters sending bona fide business samples overseas can claim applicable assistance where provided, subject to export registration, sample value and the relevant export-promotion guidelines.

Women researchers supported under SERB-POWER can receive mobility support for approved research visits/collaboration, subject to the programme’s researcher status, host institution and travel conditions.

Women in distress, including survivors of trafficking and other vulnerable circumstances, can access shelter, food, counselling, legal and rehabilitation support through Shakti Sadan, subject to admission/referral guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: SIDBI and Google Partnership for Assistance to Micro Enterprises (SanGAM)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible micro enterprises seeking formal credit and business support can access SanGAM assistance through SIDBI, subject to programme availability, enterprise eligibility and SIDBI’s credit/appraisal requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: SIDBI Assistance to Export oriented MSMEs under Ubharte Sitaare Programme (USP)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Export-oriented MSMEs with strong growth potential can seek financial and advisory support under the Ubharte Sitaare Programme. Selection depends on export potential, business viability and SIDBI/partner appraisal.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: SIDBI Make In India Soft Loan Fund For MSMEs (SMILE)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: New and existing MSMEs undertaking eligible projects can seek SMILE soft-loan assistance, subject to promoter contribution, project viability, repayment capacity and SIDBI’s credit appraisal.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: SIDBI Thematic Assistance for Purchase of Capital Assets in New Enterprises (STHAPAN)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: New enterprises purchasing eligible capital assets can seek STHAPAN assistance from SIDBI, subject to MSME eligibility, project viability, promoter contribution and applicable credit-assessment conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Single Window Clearance System for MSMEs
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: MSMEs establishing or operating units in Tamil Nadu can use the Single Window Portal to obtain applicable approvals, licences and clearances. Required eligibility depends on the specific approval and business activity.

Indian companies/startups working on innovative electronics and IT products can seek SIP-EIT support for eligible international patent filings, subject to MeitY’s entity, technology and patent-filing conditions.
Eligible youth/job seekers can receive skill training and employment support, subject to the specific programme’s age, education, residence and beneficiary-selection requirements.

Indian biotech companies and eligible entrepreneurs/startups undertaking innovative, high-risk R&D with commercial potential can apply for SBIRI support, subject to BIRAC’s company and project conditions.
MSMEs seeking finance to purchase eligible machinery/equipment can apply for SIDBI SMILE Equipment Finance, subject to business vintage, repayment capacity and SIDBI’s credit appraisal.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Special Capital Subsidy for Thrust Sector Enterprises
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible new or expanding manufacturing enterprises in Tamil Nadu’s notified thrust sectors can receive special capital subsidy, subject to enterprise category, eligible plant/machinery and State incentive conditions.

Eligible students selected under the relevant sponsorship programme can receive support for approved study, training or exposure activities. Eligibility depends on the sponsoring scheme’s academic and institutional criteria.

Women and SC/ST entrepreneurs aged 18+ starting a greenfield enterprise can apply. For non-individual enterprises, at least 51% ownership and controlling stake must be held by an eligible woman or SC/ST entrepreneur.

Startups meeting DPIIT recognition requirements can access Startup India benefits. The entity must satisfy applicable incorporation age, turnover, innovation/scalability and eligible legal-entity conditions.

DPIIT-recognised startups incorporated not more than 2 years before application can seek seed support through approved incubators. The startup should have a viable innovative idea and must not have received more than ₹10 lakh of monetary support under other government schemes, subject to specified exclusions.

Eligibility varies by the individual State MSME scheme and generally requires a qualifying MSME located or operating in the concerned State. Enterprise category, sector, investment and registration conditions depend on the specific incentive.

Exporters meeting the prescribed export-performance thresholds can apply to DGFT for Status Holder recognition. The category granted depends on export performance calculated under the Foreign Trade Policy.

Women entrepreneurs with majority ownership/control of an eligible small business can seek finance under the Stree Shakti Package, subject to the bank’s enterprise, training and credit-appraisal conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Subsidy for Asset Creation for Intellectual Property
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs incurring approved expenditure to create or register intellectual property can seek subsidy, subject to MSME status, eligible IP costs and State incentive conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Subsidy for Fund Raising from SME Exchange
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs raising equity through a recognized SME exchange can seek subsidy for approved issue/listing expenses, subject to the applicable State MSME guidelines.

A Sukanya Samriddhi account can be opened by a guardian for a girl child below 10 years of age. Normally, accounts can be opened for up to two girls in a family, with specified exceptions for multiple births.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Support for co-sponsoring events organised by associations
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSME/industry associations organizing approved entrepreneurship, technology, marketing or business-development events can seek co-sponsorship support, subject to prior approval and event guidelines.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Support for development of mini tool room
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible industry associations, clusters or institutions establishing approved mini tool rooms/common technical facilities can receive support, subject to project viability, infrastructure and State approval conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women (STEP)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women aged 16 years and above from eligible target groups can receive skill training and employment support under STEP, with implementation through approved organizations in notified sectors.

Eligible MSMEs in Tamil Nadu obtaining loans from participating lenders can receive credit-guarantee support under TNCGS, subject to enterprise eligibility, loan coverage and the scheme’s guarantee conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Tamil Nadu Startup and Innovation Mission (StartupTN / TANSIM)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Startups and aspiring entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu can access StartupTN programmes, incubation, mentoring and ecosystem support. Eligibility varies by the specific StartupTN/TANSIM initiative and may require startup recognition or Tamil Nadu presence.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund (TANSEED)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Tamil Nadu-based startups meeting TANSEED call requirements can apply for seed grants. Selection is based on innovation, scalability, team capability, market potential and the eligibility conditions of the relevant TANSEED edition.
All Schemes.Source: India - Women Entrepreneurship Support Schemes | TN MSME Compendium 2022

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission (TNSRLM)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Poor and vulnerable rural households in Tamil Nadu, especially women, are mobilized into Self-Help Groups and community institutions for livelihood, financial inclusion and skill support under TNSRLM.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Tamil Nadu Women-led Startup Industrial Plot & Marketing Support
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible women-led startups in Tamil Nadu can receive industrial-plot and marketing support, subject to StartupTN recognition, prescribed women ownership/control and the specific allotment or assistance conditions.

Male students who studied Classes 6–12 in Tamil Nadu government schools and pursue eligible higher education can receive monthly assistance, subject to the scheme’s education and enrollment requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: TANSIDCO Export Promotion and Marketing Support Scheme for MSMEs
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible Tamil Nadu MSMEs using TANSIDCO’s approved export-promotion or marketing facilities can seek support, subject to MSME registration, export/marketing activity and applicable reimbursement conditions.

Innovative startups and entrepreneurs with viable technology-oriented business ideas can seek incubation through the TANSIDCO Technology Business Incubator, subject to selection, incubation and project-viability requirements.

Eligible micro and small enterprises seeking to sell through ONDC can receive onboarding/e-commerce support under TEAM, subject to Udyam registration and the programme’s seller, digital-catalogue and onboarding requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Technology Development & Utilization Programme for Women (TDUPW)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women scientists, technologists, entrepreneurs and organizations working on technologies that improve women’s livelihoods or quality of life can seek support, subject to DST’s project, institutional and women-focused technology criteria.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Term-Loan Assistance for Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic Plants (STAR)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs/enterprises installing rooftop solar photovoltaic systems can seek term-loan assistance, subject to technical feasibility, approved project cost, repayment capacity and the lending institution’s credit appraisal.
Working women in Tamil Nadu who need safe accommodation away from home can apply for Thozhi Hostels, subject to hostel availability, employment status and the applicable admission/income conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Timely Working Capital Assistance to Revitalise Industries in Times Of Corona Crisis (TWARIT)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs affected by the COVID-19 crisis could obtain emergency working-capital support under TWARIT, subject to SIDBI’s borrower, credit and crisis-period eligibility conditions. This was a pandemic-specific facility.

MSMEs, entrepreneurs, students and industry personnel can use services of MSME Tool Rooms/Technology Centres for training, tooling, design and technical support. Eligibility depends on the specific course or service.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Trade and Industry Related Functional Support
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Eligible MSMEs and industry participants can receive functional support for trade, technology, finance, marketing or enterprise development, subject to the specific assistance programme and implementing-agency requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Trade Related Entrepreneurship Assistance and Development (TREAD)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women from economically weaker sections seeking to start income-generating enterprises can receive entrepreneurship training and credit support through eligible NGOs, subject to TREAD programme and lending conditions.

Informal micro enterprises that cannot register independently on Udyam can be brought onto the Udyam Assist Platform through designated agencies/lenders, subject to the platform’s informal-enterprise identification requirements.

Micro, small and medium enterprises meeting the Government of India’s investment and turnover classification can register on Udyam. Registration is based on Aadhaar/PAN/GST-linked information as applicable.

Women entrepreneurs and aspiring women entrepreneurs can use the Udyam Sakhi platform for entrepreneurship information, training, mentoring, market and financial guidance. Access to specific programmes may have additional eligibility requirements.

Women entrepreneurs from eligible income/category groups can obtain subsidized or concessional loans to start or expand small businesses, subject to the implementing State/corporation’s age, income, activity and lending conditions.

Eligible unemployed youth in Tamil Nadu can apply to establish a new micro enterprise, subject to the scheme’s age, education, family-income, residence, project-cost and promoter-contribution requirements.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Uttarakhand Startup Policy - Women Entrepreneur Allowance & Marketing Support
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Women-led startups recognised under Uttarakhand’s startup framework can access applicable allowance and marketing support, subject to the State’s startup recognition, women-ownership and component-specific conditions.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Vazhndhu Kaattuvom Project (VKP) / Tamil Nadu Rural Transformation Project (TNRT)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Rural households, producer groups and entrepreneurs in selected Tamil Nadu project areas can receive livelihood and enterprise support, with priority to women and vulnerable groups. Eligibility depends on VKP/TNRT component and project-area criteria.
Women in Tamil Nadu can travel free on eligible ordinary-fare State-run town buses covered by the scheme. Coverage depends on the bus/service category notified by the State.

Women scientists/researchers can receive support under WIDUSHI for advanced research, subject to the programme’s academic qualifications, research experience, age/career-stage and proposal requirements.

Women entrepreneurs/innovators meeting the relevant WInER award call criteria can be considered for recognition and support. Eligibility depends on the award edition, innovation/business category and nomination/application rules.
Women entrepreneurs and aspiring entrepreneurs can participate in WING capacity-building workshops, subject to the workshop’s registration, target-group and programme-specific selection requirements.

Women with science/engineering/medicine qualifications seeking to build careers in intellectual property can apply for WISE-IPR training, subject to DST’s qualification, age and programme-selection requirements.

Women scientists and technologists can access WISE-KIRAN programmes for research, career continuity and opportunities in science and technology. Eligibility varies by the specific WISE-KIRAN component.
Women scientists with a PhD and suitable research background can apply for WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship, subject to DST’s age, qualification, career-break and research-proposal conditions.

Women seeking to pursue a PhD in eligible science and technology disciplines can apply for WISE-PhD, subject to the prescribed qualifications, age/career conditions and admission/research requirements.

Women scientists and technologists can undertake S&T projects addressing societal challenges under WISE-SCOPE, subject to prescribed qualifications, age and proposal relevance to notified thematic areas.

Women entrepreneurs and aspiring women entrepreneurs can use WEP for information, mentorship, finance, market and ecosystem support. Eligibility for individual programmes/opportunities on the platform varies by partner and initiative.

Women affected by violence or in distress can contact the Women Helpline 181 for emergency/non-emergency support, information and referral to relevant services. Access is not limited by conventional income-based eligibility.

All Schemes.Scheme Name: Women in the Digital Economy Fund (WiDEF)
All Schemes.Eligibility Criteria: Organizations and initiatives working to improve women’s participation in the digital economy can seek support through WiDEF opportunities, subject to the specific funding call’s geography, entity and project-impact requirements.

Women in eligible STEM careers can participate in leadership-development activities under the WLS Programme, subject to the programme cohort’s professional experience, institutional and selection requirements.

Eligible businesses/MSMEs requiring funds for day-to-day operations can obtain cash-credit working capital from banks, subject to turnover, operating cycle, security, repayment capacity and lender credit appraisal.

Women entrepreneurs/MSMEs covered by the Yeshasvini campaign can access awareness, registration, credit, market and capacity-building support through participating institutions, subject to the specific service/scheme requirements.
